text: Final local audit repaired the dynamic-realization path. The upstream mesh4s primitive-validation repair is local commit 13090e1ae8a5f4c440a4d29cb62a540ab885e402 and passes full checkAll plus testFullOptJS. Existing cached SurfaceCompiler allocation remains approximately 4.65 KB per compile with exact packet reuse. A fresh monolithic ScalaFIM testAll rerun is resource-constrained by an unrelated 6 GB sbt JVM owned by another agent session; the prior full testAll receipt remains green, and newly segmented locus/pipeline/response/latent/ar/hrf/design/image/image-view gates are green.
